mapper.select: SELECT t.preference_no, t.teacher_id, l.teacher_name, l.lab_name FROM application_target t LEFT JOIN lab_info l ON l.teacher_id = t.teacher_id WHERE t.application_id = #{applicationId} ORDER BY t.preference_no ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO application_target (application_id, teacher_id, preference_no) VALUES (#{applicationId}, #{teacherId}, #{preferenceNo})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM application_target t WHERE t.application_id = #{applicationId} AND ( t.score IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM offer o WHERE o.application_target_id = t.id ) )
